description: The ATO Template Library lists only documents verified as publicly released by an official publisher, each linked to the publisher's own copy. Nothing is hosted here. Re-check the links every six months.

groups.title: Categorize
groups.note: Decide the system's confidentiality, integrity and availability impact and whether it is a national security system.

groups.title: Select
groups.note: Start from the CNSSI 1253 baseline, then tailor it with the overlays that fit the system.

groups.title: Implement
groups.note: Record how each selected control is implemented. The SSP is drafted when the controls are selected and completed here.

groups.title: Assess
groups.note: Turn the assessment's findings into risk the authorizing official can weigh.

templates.title: CNSSI 1253, Categorization and Control Selection for National Security Systems
templates.source: Committee on National Security Systems (CNSS), 1 August 2022
templates.note: Categorize a national security system with separate confidentiality, integrity and availability values, then select its control baseline. Overlays such as the Privacy Overlay tailor that baseline. On the CNSS page, open "CNSSI 1253".

templates.title: CNSS Privacy Overlay
templates.source: Committee on National Security Systems (CNSS), 31 October 2024
templates.note: Tailors the CNSSI 1253 baseline for a system that handles personally identifiable information, adding the privacy controls its sensitivity calls for. On the CNSS page, open "Privacy Overlay".

templates.title: System Security Plan (SSP) outline example
templates.source: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), SP 800-18 Rev. 2, June 2026
templates.note: NIST's example outline for a system security plan, published with SP 800-18 Rev. 2, which supersedes the 2006 Rev. 1. Its 14 sections run from the system overview, categorization and authorization boundary to the component inventory and control implementation details, and NIST says organizations can adapt it to their own needs. For a SAP system, add the CNSSI 1253 categorization and overlays and the roles your AO and PSO require.

templates.title: Risk Assessment Report (RAR) template
templates.source: Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA), May 2019
templates.note: A Tier 3 risk assessment following NIST SP 800-30: system description, scope and purpose, the likelihood, impact and risk scales, and a results table that ties each threat to its mitigating controls. Update it after testing.
